scope: Observed imported dataset patch distributions and champion choices; no persisted changes
environment: Isolated worktree task/met-32; HTTP tests use ephemeral local ports (sandbox required escalation)
limitations: No new ORM query; existing public DatasetReader used. No database resets or integration mutation required.
Real corpus provides one observed patch only; multiversion comparison example is explicitly synthetic.
Bounded metric/horizon cohort; sequence and popularity represent returned imported observations, not population or global patch catalogue.
Correlated repeated participants and selection/composition changes; no causal balance attribution or independent delta confidence interval.

reviewCorrections.duplicateIdentity: Conflicting signatures/value/context unavailable, excluded without first-row arbitration
reviewCorrections.heterogeneousDistribution: No pooled mean or quantiles across incompatible versions or units
reviewCorrections.definitionHorizon: Reject incompatible participant definition/horizon before read
reviewCorrections.orderInvariance: Conflicting duplicates and heterogeneous cells invariant to reversed input
